messages.message: `pages/MockInterviewPage/` contains `MockInterviewScorecard/index.tsx` — a screen folder holds its two halves ONLY (`component.tsx` = the shape, `index.tsx` = the wiring). Whatever this is, it has a real home: a component of its own goes to `blocks/<category>/`, a fetch goes to `hooks/`, a pure helper to `modules/utils/`, a shape to `modules/types/`, copy or a config map to `resources/`. "Only this screen uses it" is how a folder becomes a second codebase.
